upstream.repo: derived: MITRE ATT&CK + CWE + OWASP API Top 10 / ASVS 5.0
upstream.sha: re-derived 2026-09-27 against ATT&CK v19.x and ASVS 5.0.0: every ATT&CK id cited in threats.csv's Source Refs column (T1110, T1563, T1105, T1090, T1499, T1552, T1552.001, T1190, T1078.004) resolves in the current Enterprise matrix and none is deprecated or revoked — threats.csv itself carries no ASVS identifiers, so there is nothing to remap there. SKILL.md's References section cited ASVS 4.0.3's V3/V4/V5 by the old numbering; updated to 5.0.0's V7 Session Management, V8 Authorization, and V1 Encoding and Sanitization + V2 Validation and Business Logic, per the standard's own 4.0→5.0 migration guide. EXTENDED 2026-10-13 with the account-lifecycle half of the authentication class: a second authentication surface row (account lifecycle, registration, credential change) and thirteen threat rows — account enumeration (CWE-204/203/208), unverified email ownership (CWE-287/640), password acceptance (CWE-521), password storage (CWE-916/759), unsafe secret comparison and home-made credential primitives (CWE-208/338), reset beyond the token (CWE-640/362), identity or credential change (CWE-620/778), MFA and its recovery path (CWE-308), persistent login and logout (CWE-613/539), federated sign-in takeover (CWE-287/352), self-contained token validation (CWE-347), login CSRF (CWE-352) and signup abuse as a policy row (CWE-799); the credential-stuffing row was amended in place for spraying and resend throttling rather than duplicated. These rows are the first in threats.csv to carry ASVS identifiers, and the chapters cited — V2 Validation and Business Logic, V6 Authentication, V7 Session Management, V9 Self-contained Tokens, V10 OAuth and OIDC, V11 Cryptography, V16 Security Logging and Error Handling — were read from the standard's own 5.0 chapter listing on 2026-10-13 rather than recalled. The last_checked date records this extension only; the ATT&CK ids above were last re-derived 2026-09-27. Per ADR-238 no row carries a length, attempt count, iteration count, work factor or algorithm preference order: every such value defers to ASVS 5.0 V6 and NIST SP 800-63B, named in SKILL.md's References
